newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby Union-Wallabies confirm changes for Bledisloe Cup.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union-Wallabies confirm changes for Bledisloe Cup.

text.p: Australia coach Greg Smith finalised his lineup for next week's Tri-Nations rugby union test against New Zealand on Sunday, making three changes to the team which defeated England 25-6 a week ago.
Props Richard Harry and Andrew Heath were recalled to the front row at the expense of Ewen MacKenzie and Cameron Blades and No. 8 Michael Brial was chosen ahead of Troy Coker.

Smith had made no secret of the fact he was uhappy with his team's scrummaging display against the English and had foreshadowed the changes by naming an expanded 23-man squad for this week's match at the Melbourne Cricket Ground.
